text.p: Hoiupank, the second largest bank in Estonia, said on Wednesday that its board has approved a revised profit forecast for the group of 297.5 million kroons, up from the previous forecast of 140 million kroons.
The bank said in a statement that it was also rasing its profit forecast for Hoiupank to 208 million kroons from 113 million kroons.
The profit estimate's of the bank's subsidiaries were also increased from 27 million kroons to 89.5 million kroons.

The bank said that it was rasing its profit forecasts based on three expectations: growth of the domestic market of 12-13 percent; gross domestic product growth of seven percent and Hoiupank's total balance sheet volume rising to 8.6 billion kroons by the year end.
